questions.question: Explain the difference between area and perimeter using a fenced garden.
questions.expected_answer: Perimeter is the distance around the outside, like the length of the fence. Area is the amount of surface inside, like the grass. Perimeter is in units of length and area is in square units.

questions.question: Find the area of a rectangle 5 squares long and 3 squares wide, and of an L shape made from a 5 by 2 and a 2 by 2 rectangle.
questions.expected_answer: The rectangle has 3 rows of 5, so 15 square units. The L shape has 10 plus 4, which is 14 square units.

questions.question: A leaf traced on a centimetre grid covers 12 full squares and 6 half squares. Estimate its area and explain.
questions.expected_answer: The 6 half squares make 3 whole squares, because two halves make one. So the area is about 12 plus 3, which is 15 square centimetres.
